evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'let's go ahead and get you quoted' but never delivers the 10-15 minute time-box framing or 'does that sound good?' confirmation. Opens with availability check, then jumps straight to probing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: 'Bob Patel' ✓ | Moving day: 'Sunday October 11th' ✓ | Route: 'from house to house' with origin '219 Harper Street, Irving 75063' and destination '1105 [address] in flower' ✓ | Size: '2500 square feet' origin, '5000 square feet' destination ✓
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into property details without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Rep correctly identifies 2500 sq ft origin (over 1800 threshold) and offers virtual walkthrough: 'for a house for, for you know, for 2500 square footage house we need to conduct like a virtual walkthrough. It's like a conference call or FaceTime' and transitions to specialist: 'Just give me one second cause I need to endorse this to a large move specialist.'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details: Gathered: property type (house) ✓, stories (2) ✓, bedrooms (4 origin / 5 destination) ✓, parking/walking distance (20-30 feet) ✓. Missing: additional rooms detail, special considerations beyond the list mentioned, no probing on that list content.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Call ends before this section — rep transfers to specialist without completing the intake loop.

top_strength: Rep cleanly identified the 1,800+ sq ft threshold and correctly routed the call to a virtual walkthrough specialist instead of attempting to quote mid-call; discovery basics were all gathered (name, date, route, size).
coaching_note: Never ask 'Their Agenda' before probing logistics — this is the highest-leverage moment to uncover what matters most to the customer. Ask it immediately after confirming availability, before any property questions.
